messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: high-volume auth failures + unusual outbound connections from telemetry-agent on redis-prod-2. Alert level: P1. Link: https://pager.redwood.local/incident/6950001234
jamal: grabbing this — I'm oncall now. pulling logs from redis-prod-2 and analytics-forwarder hosts.
marta: thx. any customer-facing errors yet?
jamal: not seeing 500s in public APIs. internal telemetry pipeline shows repeated ACL LIST commands using svc-analytics creds then POSTs to ip-72-198-55-12.external-telemetry.io 
security-bot: IOC: outbound endpoint not in allowlist, requests timestamped 2026-03-17T17:03:12Z-17:08:50Z. ~4k requests. User agent: telemetry-agent/1.2.3.
alex: confirmed. svc-analytics key used for these requests. Host of origin: analytics-03 in prod-rack-a. Looks like an exfil attempt from the analytics worker.
jamal: immediate actions: 1) isolate analytics-03 (remove from LB) 2) revoke svc-analytics key 3) block egress to external-telemetry domain via firewall/hotpatch 4) enable audit logging on redis for that time range. I'll run the commands.
alex: I'm prepping the hotpatch. iptables rule to drop outbound to 72.198.55.12 then push to all analytics hosts. paste: ```sudo iptables -I OUTPUT -d 72.198.55.12 -j REJECT```
marta: I'll start customer-impact analysis. so far looks like internal telemetry only, no API tokens observed in payloads. still verifying for PII.
leah: legal onstandby. if logs contained metadata we may need to notify select customers. prepping notice template.
jamal: executing rotate for svc-analytics now -> `kubectl -n infra patch secret svc-analytics-creds -p '{"data":{"key":""}}'` then create fresh key. will coordinate secret rollout.
security-bot: recommend also blacklisting svc-analytics across our IAM for immediate prevention of auth to other services. I've queued IAM revoke runbook step.
alex: hotpatch applied to prod-rack-a and rolled to analytics-*. confirm: outbound to 72.198.55.12 now blocked from those nodes.
jamal: analytics-03 isolated, svc-analytics key revoked. spinning new key and injecting via secrets manager.
marta: quick findings from logs: requests mostly forwarded telemetry envelopes (no user text) + stack traces. one envelope contained base64 blob that needs deeper decode. marking for forensics.
leah: draft notice to impacted customers ready, holding until we know if any customer identifiers included.
jamal: handing off to night oncall (alex) at 18:00 UTC. alex — you'll own containment + keysync + comms with security/legal.
alex: ack taking handoff at 18:00 UTC. next steps: finish forensics decode, run full key-sync across services that used svc-analytics, rotate any derived tokens, kick off CIRT ticket.
marta: I'll add impact doc in #incidents-docs and list customers to check. initial severity: medium (internal telemetry exfil, potential metadata).
security-bot: ticket created: CIRT-2026-042, evidence archived to secure bucket (access restricted).
leah: notify customers if forensic shows identifiers. otherwise send a heads-up. legal wants 72hr update cadence.
jamal: adding postmortem owner: marta. will merge timelines and handoff notes. tagging ops-runbook for hotpatch details.
alex: leaving a short checklist for next oncall: 1) confirm no other external endpoints 2) deploy updated egress allowlist 3) validate rotated key usage 4) follow up on base64 blob decode
marta: thanks team. react :thumbsup: if you've completed your action items.
jamal: :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup:
security-bot: automated follow-up scheduled in 1h.
